'''Gaffhooks''' were primitive weapons used on [[Zelos II]]. [[Hanugar]] used a gaffhook to defend himself against [[melk]]s when his [[Wave-skimmer/Legends|wave-skimmer]] was wrecked on [[Coral/Legends|coral]] reefs.<ref name="Sepulchral">{{JournalCite|13|Day of the Sepulchral Night (short story)}}</ref>
